Kingston District Council meetings are held on the second to last Tuesday of each month, in the Council Chamber, 29 Holland Street, Kingston, at 3.00pm. Council meetings are open to the public and attendance is encouraged.
Agendas are available for public inspection at least three clear days prior to meetings and can be viewed at the Council Office (29 Holland Street) and on Council's website.
A copy of the minutes of a meeting of the Council will be placed on public display at the Council Office and Council's website within 5 days of a Council meeting.
Older documents are available upon request. Requests can be made to the Kingston District Council in person or by phone, email or mail.
